description.zh: 商家号码。可通过[ListChatGroup](~~2932629~~)接口查看商家号码。
description.en: The business phone number. You can view the business phone number by calling the [ListChatGroup](~~2932629~~) operation.

description.zh:
类型。取值：

- **WHATSAPP**。

> 暂仅支持WhatsApp通道类型的消息。
description.en:
The channel type. Valid values:

- **WHATSAPP**.

> Only the WhatsApp channel type is supported.

description.zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看。
description.en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer, which is also the instance ID. This is the channel ID, which can be viewed on the [Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page.
The group ID. You can view the group ID by calling the [ListChatGroup](~~2932629~~) operation.

description.zh:
群组头像。

> 图片限制
> - 仅支持的mime type：image/jpeg
> - 图片大小最大：5MB
> - 图片必须是正方形，最小宽高：192 x 192
description.en:
The group profile picture.

> Image restrictions:
> - Supported MIME type: image/jpeg
> - Maximum image size: 5 MB
> - The image must be square with a minimum dimension of 192 × 192 pixels.

descriptions.zh:
><notice>通过API修改IM群组功能属于Meta内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。></notice>
- 通过 API 创建WhatsApp 群组功能属于 Meta 内测功能，请联系您的商务经理申请加白。

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您已有创建成功的IM群。

- 若您没有已创建成功的IM群，可通过[AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~)接口创建IM群。
descriptions.en:
><notice>Modifying IM group information through API is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to request allowlisting.></notice>
- Creating WhatsApp groups through API is a Meta beta feature. Contact your account manager to request allowlisting.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have an IM group that has been created.

- If you do not have a created IM group, create one by calling the [AddChatGroup](~~2998429~~) operation.
